definition: The group of words for the kinds of proportion pack, told apart by what each one proportions: an order, a material module, a facade, a room, a trim family or an opening.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`pack-kind` holds the kinds of proportion pack, by what each one proportions", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
